questions.question: Which picture shows the hand signal for: turning left?
questions.explanation: Turning left (car): extend the right arm sideways from the shoulder, forearm vertical and downward from the elbow, and move it in a circular anti-clockwise motion.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 7 (p.23)

questions.question: A damaged vehicle may be removed from an accident scene without the permission of its driver or owner.
questions.explanation: The driver or owner of a damaged vehicle must give permission before it can be removed from the scene.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.62 (p.37)

questions.question: You may not stop on a bridge or within ____ of any tunnel, subway or bridge.
questions.explanation: No stopping in any tunnel or subway or on any bridge, or within 6 m of any tunnel, subway or bridge.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.48 (p.31)

questions.question: When must you increase your following distance? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: When the road is dry and clear
In rain or on a slippery surface

questions.explanation: Under adverse conditions such as rain, slippery surface, poor visibility or when being followed too closely, increase the following distance.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: Direction indicators must be visible in normal daylight at a distance of ____.
questions.explanation: Direction indicators must be clearly visible in normal daylight at a distance of 30 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.42 (p.28)

questions.question: What does this overhead lane signal mean?

options.text: You may drive in the lane below the arrow

questions.explanation: Steady green downward pointing arrow (S16): you may drive in the lane over which the arrow is displayed.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 S16 (p.56)

questions.question: A dipped beam must light up persons and objects at least 100 m ahead.
questions.explanation: A dipped beam must illuminate at least 45 m ahead; the main beam at least 100 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.3 (p.16)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Motor cars only".
questions.explanation: Motor cars only (R117): only motor cars may use this road or part of the road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R117 (p.7)

questions.question: What is the speed limit in the area marked by this sign?
questions.explanation: Woonerf (R403): the speed of vehicles in the area is limited to 30 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.5 R403 (p.19)

questions.question: This sign is shown at road works. What must you do?

options.text: Proceed at the normal speed limit
Proceed with caution if it is safe
Stop and wait until the sign is turned around

questions.explanation: STOP/RY-GO (R1.5): stop when STOP is displayed; move off or proceed with caution if safe when GO is displayed.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1.5 (p.4)

questions.question: When angle-parking in a bay like this, how far may the front of your vehicle be from the kerb?

options.text: Any distance as long as you are inside the lines

questions.explanation: Parking bay (RM6): in the case of angle parking, park with the front of the vehicle not further than 150 mm from the kerb, with no part on or over the sidewalk.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM6 (p.49)

questions.question: Match each control with its purpose.

options.text: To clean the front windscreen (e.g. when driving in the rain)
To change the direction of the vehicle (steer left or right)
To alert other road users in order to avoid a collision

questions.explanation: Gear lever: to select a gear. Steering wheel: to change the direction of the vehicle (steer left or right). Window wiper: to clean the front windscreen (e.g. when driving in the rain). Horn: to alert other road users in order to avoid a collision.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Towed vehicles prohibited (no towing beyond this sign)".
questions.explanation: Towed vehicles prohibited (R240): do not enter if you are towing another vehicle or trailer.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R240 (p.15)

questions.question: Signalling very early is always safest, even if it may confuse other road users.
questions.explanation: Care should be taken not to signal too early where it could create confusion for other road users.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 6 (p.22)

questions.question: This sign means: "Sharp curve to the left".
questions.explanation: False. Traffic circle (W201): slow down; if there is no other indication yield to traffic from the right. Vehicles within the circle have right of way. ("Sharp curve to the left" is the meaning of W205.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W201 (p.25)

questions.question: You should adjust your rear-view mirrors only while the vehicle is stationary.
questions.explanation: Adjust rear-view mirror(s) for maximum rear-view vision only whilst the vehicle is stationary.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 5 (p.21)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: End of the 12 t mass limit
End of the requirement to switch headlamps on

questions.explanation: De-restriction (R600 series): a red cross cancels the restriction shown.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R202-600 (p.22)

questions.question: What is the "service brake" of a vehicle?

options.text: The brake (normally the footbrake) used to slow down or stop the vehicle in the ordinary course of events
A brake used only in emergencies
The hand brake used to keep the vehicle stationary
The brake fitted to a trailer

questions.explanation: "Service brake" means a brake, normally a footbrake, used in the ordinary course of events to reduce speed or stop the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.8)

questions.question: This sign means: "Parking (vehicles under 3 500 kg GVM, no time limit, fee payable)".
questions.explanation: Parking reservation (R305-P): parking for vehicles with a GVM of less than 3 500 kg; no time limit but a fee must be paid.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R305-P (p.16)

questions.question: The headlamp of a motorcycle must be switched on at all times while riding on a public road.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle's headlamp must be kept on at all times when the motorcycle is ridden on a public road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.1.1 (p.16)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Stop sign ahead".
questions.explanation: Traffic control "STOP" ahead (W302): there is a stop sign ahead which cannot be seen in time.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W302 (p.26)

questions.question: In an urban area you may park over the actuating mechanism (sensor) of a traffic signal.
questions.explanation: No parking upon or over the actuating mechanism of a traffic signal.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.47 (p.31)

questions.question: The engine or exhaust brake of a heavy vehicle should not be used in a built-up area.
questions.explanation: The engine brake should not be used in a built-up area.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Heavy Motor Vehicle manual, Glossary – Engine brake / Exhaust brake (p.76)

questions.question: What does "disengage" the clutch mean?

options.text: Depressing the clutch pedal to disconnect the engine from the transmission

questions.explanation: Disengage: depressing the clutch pedal to disconnect the engine from the transmission.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Disengage (p.80)

questions.question: A pedestrian may cross a public road only at a pedestrian crossing or intersection, or at a distance of more than how far from them?
questions.explanation: A pedestrian may cross only at a pedestrian crossing or intersection, or further than 50 m from such a crossing or intersection.
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 316(6)

questions.question: The driver must ensure that a child uses an appropriate child restraint where one is available.
questions.explanation: The driver must ensure a child uses an appropriate child restraint where available, otherwise a seatbelt if available.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.17.1 (p.21)

questions.question: What is a "traffic lane"?

options.text: Any road with a centre line
A longitudinal division of a road wide enough for a single line of vehicles

questions.explanation: "Traffic lane" means a longitudinal division of a public road of sufficient width for the passage of a single line of vehicles.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)

questions.question: Which controls help you see traffic behind you? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Controls 1 and 3 are used to see what is to the rear and sides of the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Heavy vehicles may not overtake other heavy vehicles (500 m)

questions.explanation: Axle mass limit (R203): if any axle of your vehicle exceeds the mass shown, use another road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R203 (p.11)

questions.question: You need a learner's licence before you may legally be trained to drive a vehicle on a public road.
questions.explanation: A learner's licence is required before a person can legally be trained to drive a vehicle on a public road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Information for learner's licence test (p.10)

questions.question: This sign means: "Goods vehicles only".
questions.explanation: Goods vehicles only (R123): the road or part of the road is set aside for goods vehicles.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R123 (p.8)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Pedestrians may be crossing for the next 2 km

questions.explanation: Pedestrians (W307): pedestrians may be crossing the road for the next 2 km.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W307 (p.27)

questions.question: Passengers are carried seated on the back of a goods vehicle. How high must the sides of the body be?

options.text: At least 350 mm above the surface on which they sit

questions.explanation: Sides must be at least 350 mm high where persons are seated, or 900 mm where they stand.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.34 (p.26)

questions.question: In which situations may a vehicle stand on the road at night without its lights on? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: When parked in a demarcated parking place
When parked within 12 m of a lighted street lamp
When parked on a freeway shoulder

questions.explanation: Lamps are not required for a vehicle parked off the roadway, in a demarcated parking place, or within 12 m of a lighted street lamp illuminating the road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.1.2 (p.16)

questions.question: The rule that roof loads may not exceed half the height of a motor car does not apply to pedal cycles carried on the roof.
questions.explanation: The half-height limit is not applicable to pedal cycles transported on the roof of a motor vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.33 (p.25)

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with this sign under the traffic light?

options.text: Do not move off when approaching traffic moves off – wait for your own green
Move off when oncoming traffic moves off

questions.explanation: Multi-phase traffic signals (IN15): your signal may remain red while the opposite direction gets green; wait until your signal is green.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN15 (p.47)

questions.question: Put these steps for moving off in a manual car in the correct order.

options.text: Check rear-view mirror(s) and appropriate blind spot

questions.explanation: LMV Module 12 (moving off, manual transmission).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 12 (p.28)

questions.question: The owner of a vehicle may employ a person to drive it on a public road only if that person is licensed to drive that vehicle.
questions.explanation: No owner may employ or permit any person to drive the vehicle unless that person is licensed to drive it.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.6 (p.14)

questions.question: The gear lever of an automatic car operates differently from that of a manual gearbox.
questions.explanation: The gear lever for an automatic vehicle operates differently from a manual gearbox system.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Another vehicle is overtaking you. What must you do?

options.text: Keep as far left as safely possible and do not accelerate until it has passed
Move to the right to block it
Accelerate so that it can pass more quickly

questions.explanation: When being passed, drive as near to the left edge as is safe and do not accelerate until the other vehicle has passed.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.45 (p.29)

questions.question: Which number shows the centre rear-view mirror in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The centre rear-view mirror is number 1.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Dead end: turn left or right"?
questions.explanation: Dead-end (W410): the road does not continue beyond the sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W410 (p.34)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pay toll ahead (last chance to take the alternative route)

questions.explanation: Pay toll (R132): your last opportunity to follow an alternative route, or proceed and pay the toll.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R132 (p.9)

questions.question: A pre-advance exit direction sign (GA1) is placed about ____ before the off-ramp.
questions.explanation: Pre-advance exit direction (GA1): on a freeway, about 2 km before an off-ramp exit.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.2 GA1 (p.42)

questions.question: Tap the indicator light switch in this manual-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The indicator light switch is control 5.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: In which conditions may fog lamps be used? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Fog lamps may only be used in conditions of snow, fog, mist, dust or smoke.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.9 (p.18)

questions.question: What does this signal mean?

options.text: Stop, then turn left if clear

questions.explanation: Red: stop.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 Traffic signals (p.56)

questions.question: You may use a motorcycle to tow another vehicle if the tow-rope is shorter than 3,5 m.
questions.explanation: No person shall use any motorcycle to tow another vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.57 (p.36)

questions.question: This road marking means: "No-overtaking line".
questions.explanation: False. Pedestrian crossing (RTM3/RTM4): give pedestrians priority. ("No-overtaking line" is the meaning of RM1.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RTM4 (p.48)

questions.question: Which number shows the indicator light switch in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The indicator light switch is number 5.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: While waiting in an intersection to turn right, should your front wheels be turned?

options.text: Yes – turned fully to the right
No – keep them straight where possible

questions.explanation: When stopping to turn right, ensure that the wheels are straight where possible (so you are not pushed into oncoming traffic if hit from behind).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 35 (p.56)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved for vehicles of disabled persons

questions.explanation: Disabled persons vehicle reservation (R323).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R323 (p.18)

questions.question: A code 1 learner's licence allows you to carry a passenger on a motorcycle.
questions.explanation: A code 1 learner's licence does not authorise the carrying of passengers.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.1 (p.12)

questions.question: This sign means: "Reduced visibility (fog or smoke) ahead".
questions.explanation: Reduced visibility (W354): fog or smoke may reduce visibility.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W354 (p.32)

questions.question: Pair each regulatory sign with its meaning.
questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R237: Animal-drawn vehicles prohibited. Sign 2 is R208: Unauthorised vehicles prohibited. Sign 3 is R204: Height limit 4,42 m. Sign 4 is R227: Buses prohibited.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R237 (p.15), R208 (p.12), R204 (p.11), R227 (p.14)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Lane ends: the right-hand lane ends"?
questions.explanation: Lane ends (W214): the road narrows by a full lane from the right-hand side; change in good time to the lane that carries on.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W214 (p.26)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pedal cyclists (W309): look out for cyclists for the next 2 km.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W309 (p.27)

questions.question: A semi-trailer is designed so that at least ____ of its tare is borne by the drawing vehicle.
questions.explanation: At least 15 per cent of a semi-trailer's tare is superimposed on the drawing vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.8)

questions.question: Hold the steering wheel in a ten-to-two or ____ position.
questions.explanation: Hands in a ten-to-two or quarter-to-three position.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 14 (p.30)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Stop".
questions.explanation: Stop sign: bring your vehicle to a complete stop behind the stop line (or in line with the sign if there is no line) and proceed only when it is safe.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1 (p.4)

questions.question: Motorcyclists riding in separate traffic lanes are each regarded as being on a separate public road for the single-file rule.
questions.explanation: Where a road is divided into traffic lanes, each lane is regarded as a public road for the single-file rule.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.50 (p.33)

questions.question: What does "towing" mean?

options.text: Towing a vehicle that is not designed or adapted to be drawn

questions.explanation: "Towing" means towing a vehicle that is not designed or adapted for being drawn (as opposed to "drawing" a trailer).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)

questions.question: Put these steps for an incline start in a manual car in the correct order.

options.text: Stop without allowing the vehicle to move backwards

questions.explanation: LMV Module 17 (incline start, manual transmission).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 17 (p.35)

questions.question: This sign means: "Pedal cyclists ahead (next 2 km)".
questions.explanation: Pedal cyclists (W309): look out for cyclists for the next 2 km.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W309 (p.27)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Advance exit direction sign (about 1 km before the off-ramp)
Gore exit sign: pass left to exit, right to stay on the freeway

questions.explanation: Exit direction (GA3): as close as possible to the off-ramp; only leave if you are in the left lane.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.2 GA3 (p.42)

questions.question: How should you check that the parking brake will hold the vehicle?

options.text: Switch off the engine and open the door

questions.explanation: To determine whether the vehicle will remain stationary with the parking brake applied, the service brake should be released slowly.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Parking brake (p.83)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Pedal cycles and pedestrians prohibited"?
questions.explanation: R220: cyclists and pedestrians may not proceed beyond this sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R220 (p.13)

questions.question: Pair each regulatory sign with its meaning.

options.text: Roundabout: move clockwise and yield to traffic from the right

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R112: Cyclists and pedestrians only. Sign 2 is R130: Agricultural vehicles only. Sign 3 is R116: Motorcycles only. Sign 4 is R137: Roundabout: move clockwise and yield to traffic from the right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R112 (p.7), R130 (p.9), R116 (p.7), R137 (p.10)

questions.question: You may switch on your fog lamps at night simply to see better on a clear, dark road.
questions.explanation: Fog lamps may only be used in snow, fog, mist, dust or smoke.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.9 (p.18)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Turn left ahead only".
questions.explanation: Turn left only (R108): you must turn in the direction of the arrow at the intersection ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R108 (p.6)

questions.question: What is a "traffic island"?

options.text: A physical island that serves as a channelising device within a junction or on a public road
The centre of a freeway interchange

questions.explanation: "Traffic island" means a physical island that serves as a channelising device within a junction or on a public road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Left turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn right)"?
questions.explanation: Left turn prohibited (R211): you may proceed straight or turn right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R211 (p.12)

questions.question: Tap the gear lever in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The gear lever is control 6.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Domestic animals on the road (next 2 km)

questions.explanation: Children (W308): children might be crossing or playing in the road; slow down immediately.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W308 (p.27)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?
questions.explanation: Pedestrians only (R110): the road or part of the road may be used by pedestrians only.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R110 (p.6)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Danger plate: do not pass to the right of it
T-junction chevron: road does not continue straight

questions.explanation: Traffic signals out of order (TW412): slow down, yield and be ready to stop.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW412 (p.34)

questions.question: Both the rider and the passenger of a motorcycle must wear protective helmets.
questions.explanation: Protective helmets must be worn by riders and passengers of motorcycles.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.18 (p.21)

questions.question: Which controls must be used together to change gear in a manual car? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: In order to change a gear, you use controls 6 (gear lever) and 8 (clutch).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Agricultural vehicles may cross or enter the road

questions.explanation: Grader working (TW337): drive slowly past the grader.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW337 (p.30)

questions.question: During moving off, what must you avoid?
questions.explanation: The applicant shall not cause the wheels of the vehicle to spin while moving off.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 12 (p.28)

questions.question: What is the breath alcohol limit for an ordinary driver?

options.text: Less than 0,10 mg per 1 000 ml of breath
Less than 0,50 mg per 1 000 ml of breath
Less than 0,05 mg per 1 000 ml of breath
Less than 0,24 mg per 1 000 ml of breath

questions.explanation: No person shall drive while the breath alcohol concentration is not less than 0,24 mg per 1 000 ml (0,10 mg for professional drivers).
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, s65(5)

questions.question: This sign means: "Gore exit sign: pass left to exit, right to stay on the freeway".
questions.explanation: Gore exit (GA4): pass on its left if leaving the freeway and on its right if not.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.2 GA4 (p.42)

questions.question: What is a "dedicated lane"?

options.text: A portion of the road reserved during certain periods for the exclusive use of certain categories of vehicles, as shown by a sign
A lane reserved for emergency stopping

questions.explanation: "Dedicated lane" means a portion of the public road reserved during certain periods for the exclusive use of certain categories of motor vehicles, prescribed by a sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.3)

questions.question: What is an "urban area"?

options.text: The part of a local authority's area surveyed and subdivided into erven (or surrounded by them), including the abutting public roads
Any area with a 60 km/h sign
Any area within 5 km of a city centre

questions.explanation: "Urban area" means that portion of a local authority's area subdivided into erven by actual survey, or surrounded by surveyed erven, and includes the abutting public roads.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Yield sign ahead"?
questions.explanation: Traffic control "YIELD" ahead (W303): there is a yield sign ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W303 (p.27)

questions.question: At this traffic circle sign, who may proceed first?

options.text: The driver who reaches his or her yield line first
The driver travelling on the busier road
The driver approaching from the left

questions.explanation: Yield at traffic circle (R2.2): the driver who reaches his/her yield line first may proceed first.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R2.2 (p.5)

questions.question: What is the "emergency brake"?

options.text: A brake used only on trailers
A brake, other than the service brake, which can stop the vehicle

questions.explanation: "Emergency brake" means a brake, other than a service brake, which can stop a vehicle (the parking brake may serve as the emergency brake).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.3); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.14 (p.19)

questions.question: Driving in a manner that wilfully disregards the safety of persons or property is called…
questions.explanation: Reckless or negligent driving includes driving in a manner that wilfully disregards the safety of persons or property.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.64 (p.38)

questions.question: Look at the picture of an urban road. Which car is parked too close to the intersection?
questions.explanation: Car B is within 5 m of the intersection.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.47 (p.31)

questions.question: What is the maximum overall height of a motor vehicle other than a double-deck bus?
questions.explanation: Overall height of any other motor vehicle may not exceed 4,3 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.31 (p.25)

questions.question: The release mechanism (button) of the hand brake should be used when applying it, to avoid wear or strain.
questions.explanation: The release mechanism shall be used when applying the parking brake to avoid wear or strain.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Release mechanism (p.83)

questions.question: What does this marking in your lane warn you about?
questions.explanation: Yield control ahead (WM5): there is a yield sign ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.2 WM5 (p.53)

questions.question: When moving off on a motorcycle, how should it be kept stationary before moving?

options.text: By holding the clutch lever only
By putting both feet down only

questions.explanation: Keep the motorcycle stationary by applying the rear brake.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 12 (p.29)

questions.question: What is the window wiper used for?

options.text: To see what is to the rear and sides of the vehicle
To increase the speed of the vehicle
To clean the front windscreen (e.g. when driving in the rain)
To change the direction of the vehicle (steer left or right)

questions.explanation: The window wiper is used to clean the front windscreen (e.g. when driving in the rain).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: You should cancel your indicator once the manoeuvre has been completed.
questions.explanation: Ensure that the signal is cancelled after completing the manoeuvre.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 6 (p.22)

questions.question: Tap the brake in this manual-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The brake is control 9.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: The owner of a vehicle can be held responsible for offences committed with the vehicle if the owner allowed it to be used.
questions.explanation: The owner is also responsible for offences committed with his/her vehicle if he/she permitted its use.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.9 (p.15)

questions.question: What must accompany an application for a learner's licence? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Form LL1 must be accompanied by two identical photographs, acceptable identification (and a copy), a medical certificate if 65 or older, and the fee.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.4 (p.14)

questions.question: When may you use your hooter?

options.text: Only when it is necessary for safety reasons
To tell a slow driver to hurry up

questions.explanation: The hooter may only be used when necessary for reasons of road safety.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.15 (p.20); National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 310A

questions.question: This sign means: "Beginning of dual roadway".
questions.explanation: False. Staggered junction (W109): a road joins from the right first and then, a short distance on, from the left. ("Beginning of dual roadway" is the meaning of W118.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.1 W109 (p.24)
